references.text: The story of Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden, where the serpent tempts Eve, can be seen as a parallel to how Jesus is tempted by the devil.
Here it is mentioned how God will command his angels to protect the righteous, and Satan uses this verse to tempt Jesus in the wilderness.
This verse speaks about how Jesus has been tempted in every way that we are, yet without sinning, which includes the event in Matthew 4:3.
